style: ULTRA-REALISTIC natural look, like a high-resolution photograph of a real object cut out on transparent background, true-to-life materials (worn wood grain, chipped paint, rust, scuffed plastic, dents), true natural colours (not desaturated, not stylized), soft natural daylight from the top-left, crisp fine detail. Post-Soviet everyday objects. NOT cartoon, NOT painterly, NOT AI-art look, no glow, no outline.
